source:
@@U02053@@
浮士德 with a bunch of keys and a lantern, in front of a narrow iron door.

@@U02055@@
What a shudder runs through me. How long it’s been. I thought I'd forgotten. All the misery of mankind grips me. She’s here, here where she lives, behind this dripping wall, yet her crime was no more than a fond illusion. And now you, 浮士德, you, now you think twice about going to her. Afraid? Afraid to see her again? Go, go on, you fool! Your timidity only brings death closer!

@@U02056@@
(He takes hold of the lock.)

@@U02058@@
(Singing from within.)

@@U02059@@
My mother, the whore, She took my life, My father, the rogue, Ate me up with his knife! My sister, wee tyke, She picked up my bones, And laid them to cool Down under the stones. Then I turned to a woodbird So pretty to see; Fly away, fly away To the woodland with me!

@@U02061@@
(Unlocking the door.)

@@U02062@@
She doesn’t know her lover can hear her chains rattle, and the rustle of the straw.
translation:
@@U02053@@
浮士德拿着一串钥匙和一盏灯笼，在一扇狭窄的铁门前。

@@U02055@@
我感到多么不寒而栗。已经多久了。我以为我忘记了。人类所有的苦难都紧紧抓住我。她在这里，在这里她居住的地方，在这堵滴水的墙后面，但她的罪行只不过是一个美好的幻想。现在你，浮士德，你，现在你要三思而行去找她。害怕的？害怕再见到她？走吧，继续吧，你这个傻瓜！你的胆怯只会让死亡更近！

@@U02056@@
（他抓住了锁。）

@@U02058@@
（从内心歌唱。）

@@U02059@@
我的母亲，那个妓女，她夺走了我的生命，我的父亲，那个流氓，用他的刀把我吃掉了！我的妹妹，小家伙，她捡起我的骨头，把它们放在石头下面冷却。然后我转向一只林鸟，看起来非常漂亮；飞吧，飞吧，跟我一起去森林吧！

@@U02061@@
（打开门。）

@@U02062@@
她不知道她的爱人能听到她的铁链嘎嘎作响，还有稻草的沙沙声。
